name: New Tel
summary: Perth-listed carrier (New Tel Ltd, ASX+Nasdaq) focused on international/national voice+data; bought DigiPlus Mar 2002 ($50m); administration Dec 2002; customer base to RSL COM late 2002.

events.details: Perth-based listed telecommunications carrier (international/national voice+data, Asia/China focus); ASX- and Nasdaq-listed.
Administration 10 Dec 2002 (PWC); liquidation Feb-Mar 2003 ($40-50m liabilities); customer base to RSL COM late 2002.
